description:
TechFlow Solutions is submitting a proposal for the 'Municipal Wi-Fi Expansion Project' (RFP #2026-WIFI-09) to the City of Oakdale. You must format the technical volume exactly according to the client's strict instructions to avoid disqualification.

1. Open the draft text from '/home/ga/Documents/draft_proposal.json'.
2. Open the formatting guide from '/home/ga/Documents/formatting_requirements.txt'.
3. Create a new OpenOffice Writer document.
4. Copy the content from the JSON file into the document.
5. Apply 'Heading 1' paragraph style to the four section titles (Executive Summary, Technical Approach, Implementation Plan, Past Performance).
6. Configure the Page Layout (Format > Page) to have exactly 1.00 inch (or 2.54 cm) margins on all sides (Top, Bottom, Left, Right).
7. Add a Header containing exactly: 'RFP #2026-WIFI-09 - Technical Volume'.
8. Add a Footer containing a page number field.
9. Save the document as '/home/ga/Documents/TechFlow_Proposal_Volume_I.odt'.
